model_meta.system_name: Low-pressure screw compressor with axial rotor bias
model_meta.description: Concept-level model of the claimed compressor rotor, bearing-support, and axial-bias arrangement.

subsystems.description: Encloses the engaging rotor bodies and provides inlet-side and outlet-side bearing locations.
Driving male-screw rotor and driven female-screw rotor, each built around a shaft; they rotate within the housing and engage each other.
One loose deep-groove ball bearing supports each rotor shaft at the inlet side; each bearing outer ring can shift axially in the housing and the inner ring is fixed to its shaft.

parts.description: Loose deep-groove ball bearing at each shaft's inlet-side support

subsystems.description: A fixed cylindrical roller bearing supports each rotor shaft at the outlet side.

parts.description: Fixed cylindrical roller bearing at each shaft's outlet-side support

subsystems.description: At least one spring device extends between housing and rotor body, directly or through the inlet bearing outer ring, and biases one or both rotor bodies toward the outlet side.

requirements.statement: The spring device arrangement shall urge one or both rotor bodies toward the outlet side so that minimum axial clearance between the rotor bodies and housing at the outlet side is maintained.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; states the claimed functional outcome without specifying a numerical clearance.

actions.name: Bias rotors to maintain outlet clearance

steps.description: Transmit spring force from the rotor housing, optionally through the inlet-bearing outer ring, to one or both rotor bodies toward the outlet side.
Maintain minimum axial clearance between rotor bodies and the housing at the outlet side.
